hooks.name: Block terraform apply from agent
hooks.description: Apply discipline (.kiro/steering/delegation-and-safety.md): blocks any terraform apply/destroy except an apply of a saved plan file named *.approved.tfplan, which the orchestrating session creates only after the user agreed to the plan. Subagents are plan-only.

action.command:
cmd=$(python3 -c "import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
ti=d.get('toolInput') or d.get('tool_input') or {}
print(ti.get('command','') if isinstance(ti,dict) else '')" 2>/dev/null || python -c "import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
ti=d.get('toolInput') or d.get('tool_input') or {}
print(ti.get('command','') if isinstance(ti,dict) else '')" 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq "terraform([[:space:]]+-chdir=[^[:space:]]+)?[[:space:]]+destroy"; then echo "BLOCKED: terraform destroy is not allowed from agents (.kiro/steering/delegation-and-safety.md)." >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq "terraform([[:space:]]+-chdir=[^[:space:]]+)?[[:space:]]+apply"; then if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq "apply[^;|&]*\.approved\.tfplan"; then exit 0; fi; echo "BLOCKED: terraform apply is only allowed for a saved plan file *.approved.tfplan, created by the orchestrating session after the user agreed to the plan (.kiro/steering/delegation-and-safety.md). Produce a plan and ask the user." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
